content.thinking:
I'm planning the design: a koala gripping a eucalyptus branch stand, with a base plinth and vertical trunk rooted at floor level, sized around 0.7 meters tall while sitting in the fork.

Deciding on the pose now, I'll have the koala sit astride a curved branch extending forward from the trunk, facing the viewer with arms wrapped around the branch in front rather than hugging the trunk directly, so its face stays visible.

For construction, I'll build this with the available builder API, using low-poly spheres and boxes shaped with cellPaint for a chunky pixel-art fur look, mixing boxy forms for the body with rounded spheres for the head to keep that stylized voxel feel.

Working out the koala's proportions and placement now: a cylinder base disk, a tapered trunk swept along a curved path with bark shading, and a branch extending out where the koala will sit, all positioned relative to the trunk's coordinate origin.

For the koala itself, I'm sizing the body as a slightly leaning box sitting on top of the branch, with the head box overlapping the body's top, and now I'm building rounded ear shapes using thin cylinders angled to face outward.

I'm placing the ears, nose, and eyes with specific offsets relative to the head's front plane, giving the nose a small forward protrusion and adding tiny black boxes for eyes with a glint detail.

Now I'm continuing with cheek fluff positioned at the lower sides of the head, a cream chest patch overlapping the body's front plane, and arms modeled as gray rods extending from the shoulders down to wrap around a branch, with small claw boxes detailing the hands gripping the wood.

For legs, I'm building thighs as rods running from the hips down to foot boxes that grip the branch, with claws added and positions adjusted so everything overlaps naturally without gaps. Now I'm setting up the fur texture painting function.

Defining the color ramps...

I'll skip precise hit-position filtering and just use a normal.y filter with minDist 0.09, scattering around 40 leaves on the trunk and 14 on the branch. I'm also adding a second forked branch sweeping up top, plus some gnarl-knot boxes and a flat-capped stump bump at the branch tip, while leaving out extras like a held leaf or tail detail.

For the koala's fur, I'm setting up small white box tufts on the ears, chest fringe, and belly, using a seeded random/noise helper and a `pick` function to select colors from a ramp. Parts are built with a box helper that takes size, position, color, and rotation, and I'm placing pixel-art textured eye planes (with a glint highlight) on the front face, checking that the overall koala-on-trunk height lands around 1.1 meters.

Now I'm adding small dark-cream claw boxes to each hand, filling in the metadata fields (name, description, style, commit message), and double-checking the imports so nothing unused slips in before finalizing the code.
